title: myhead
summary: head(1) on standard input: 10 lines or the first N (-N), read with fgets.
hints: Declare `char buf[1024];` and loop `while (count < n && fgets(buf, 1024, stdin) != NULL)`, printing each line with `fputs(buf, stdout)`.
The option is `argv[1]` = `-N`: `atoi(argv[1] + 1)` skips the dash.
